userStories.title: User profile page - Basic layout
userStories.description: Create the foundational user profile page at /profile/[username]. This is a Next.js App Router page. The project uses Tailwind CSS with a dark theme, TypeScript, and Airtable as the database via src/lib/services/airtable.ts. Existing page patterns can be found in src/app/report/[id]/page.tsx and src/app/intel/page.tsx. The AirtableService already has getUserByUsername() and getUserById() methods. Use existing components from src/components/common/ (Badge, Button, LoadingSpinner, SkeletonCard) and src/components/layout/ (Header, Footer). The StatusBadge component in src/components/reports/ shows how role badges work.
acceptanceCriteria: Page accessible at /profile/[username] using Next.js App Router (src/app/profile/[username]/page.tsx)
Shows username prominently and user role badge (User/Moderator/Admin) using existing Badge component patterns
Displays account creation date in a readable format
Shows a placeholder section for stats (will be filled by GH-P6-002)
Shows a placeholder section for recent activity (will be filled by GH-P6-003)
Responsive layout works on mobile and desktop using Tailwind CSS
Dark theme consistent with existing pages (bg-gray-900, text-white pattern)
TypeScript compiles without new errors (pre-existing errors are acceptable)
